title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
The
**Lead Forward Deployed Engineer**
operates at the intersection of engineering, data, and customer deployment. In this hands-on, customer-facing role, you will lead complex enterprise onboardings to integrate, transform, and operationalize cybersecurity data into Qualys’ Enterprise TruRisk Management (ETM) platform. You will translate fragmented security environments into a unified risk model while bridging the gap between customer needs and core product engineering.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Customer Onboarding & Data Integration
  
  

* Strategic Execution: Lead end-to-end enterprise onboarding from strategy to production rollout, serving as the system of record for customer assets, findings, and business context.
* Pipeline & API Design: Build REST API, webhook, and scalable ingestion (e.g., S3-based ETL/ELT) pipelines to integrate diverse data sources (VM, EDR/XDR, Cloud, IAM, CMDBs, GRC).
* Data Modeling & Correlation: Design custom mapping, transformation, tagging, and asset criticality scoring; implement de-duplication and correlation logic across heterogeneous security feeds.
* Pipeline Reliability: Ensure continuous full and incremental data ingestion with automated scheduling, monitoring, and error handling.

Data Quality & Validation
  
  

* Data Integrity: Establish scalable validation frameworks to audit and maintain asset/findings accuracy for confident risk decision-making.
* Issue Resolution: Execute controlled reprocessing and configuration adjustments to fix data quality issues without disrupting operational metrics.

Dashboards, Remediation & Workflows
  
  

* Analytics & Modeling: Build customized dashboards, trend visualizations, and risk scoring models, including complex "toxic risk combination" scenarios.
* Workflow Automation: Integrate ETM with ticketing/remediation tools (Jira, ServiceNow) and configure automated alerts, escalations, and ownership mapping.
* Executive Reporting: Develop custom reports/utilities using public APIs for board-level, operational, and regulatory audiences.

Product & Engineering Feedback Loop
  
  

* Roadmap Influence: Translate field deployment challenges and recurring integration gaps into technical requirements for product and core engineering teams.
* Customer Maturity: Guide enterprises from initial risk visibility to automated, remediation-driven action.

Required Qualifications:
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience: 8–10 years in data engineering, platform engineering, or customer-facing technical roles.
* Technical Stack:
* Strong programming proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages.
* Deep experience with REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous systems, and scalable ingestion pipelines (ETL/ELT).
* Hands-on knowledge of relational, NoSQL, search, or graph databases.
* Domain & Data Expertise:
* Strong foundation in data modeling, normalization, transformation, and correlation.
* Solid understanding of core cybersecurity domains (VM, Cloud Security, IAM, Risk Frameworks).
* Hands-on application of AI or automation to optimize data pipelines and onboarding workflows.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional client-facing, communication, and technical consultation skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Background in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Professional Services.
* Familiarity with large-scale, distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Proven ability to thrive in high-impact, fast-paced, and ambiguous production environments.

title: Executive – MD’s Office | Technical Coordination, MIS & AI Operations
description:
**Executive – MD’s Office | Technical Coordination, MIS & AI Operations**

Swid Renewables Limited is seeking a technically capable, highly organised and proactive professional to work closely with the Managing Director and drive coordination, management follow-ups and execution across the business.

The core responsibility is to
**ensure that management decisions and delegated responsibilities translate into timely action and measurable outcomes**
. Strong MIS capabilities, disciplined follow-up and proficiency in using AI agents are essential.

**This is a business execution and management coordination role within the MD’s Office. It does not involve personal assistance or personal errands.**

**Key responsibilities :**

**Management follow-up and execution**

* Track decisions, commitments and responsibilities delegated by the Managing Director.
* Follow up consistently with department heads, managers and relevant teams against agreed deadlines.
* Maintain a central action tracker with clear owners, priorities, due dates, dependencies and status.
* Identify delays and bottlenecks, obtain actionable updates and escalate matters requiring the Managing Director’s intervention.
* Verify completion through relevant records or deliverables before closing action items.

**MIS, analytics and management reporting**

* Own the preparation and accuracy of MIS reports, dashboards and periodic management updates.
* Compile, organise and analyse information across projects, operations, sales, finance and other functions.
* Highlight performance gaps, overdue commitments, emerging risks and matters requiring decisions.
* Use advanced Excel and relevant reporting tools to turn business data into clear, actionable insights.

**AI agents and workflow improvement**

* Use AI agents and AI-enabled tools effectively for research, communication review, meeting summaries, action tracking, reporting and business analysis.
* Build and improve recurring workflows that reduce manual effort and strengthen follow-up.
* Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and handle confidential business information with discretion.

**Communication and priority management**

* Review and manage authorised business communication channels, including email, WhatsApp and incoming calls.
* Prioritise messages, coordinate timely responses and bring urgent or significant matters to the Managing Director’s attention.
* Keep the Managing Director’s task list, pending decisions and follow-up priorities current and readily available.
* Coordinate meetings and prepare agendas, briefing notes, presentations and minutes.
* Maintain organised records of important communication, decisions and supporting documents.

**Technical and strategic support**

* Understand technical discussions, project updates and operational issues well enough to track commitments and coordinate effectively with relevant teams.
* Support the Managing Director with research, analysis, presentations and strategic initiatives.
* Help translate strategic priorities into practical action plans, milestones and review schedules.

**Daily working approach**

1. **Review communication:**
   Check email, WhatsApp and all designated business communication channels for updates, requests and pending matters.
2. **Handle and prioritise:**
   Attend to calls, messages and correspondence; coordinate responses and flag urgent issues.
3. **Maintain the action list:**
   Keep a consolidated, up-to-date list of tasks, decisions, commitments and priorities ready for the Managing Director.
4. **Follow up and escalate:**
   Review delegated work with responsible managers, record progress, resolve coordination gaps and escalate delays with a clear summary and proposed next steps.
5. **Support strategy:**
   Prepare MIS insights, research and recommendations to support business planning and management decisions.

**What we’re looking for**

* A technical qualification, preferably a degree or diploma in engineering or a related discipline.
* 5 years+ of relevant experience in management coordination, technical operations, project coordination, MIS or an MD’s/CEO’s office.
* **Strong MIS and advanced Excel skills**
  , including data analysis, dashboards and management reporting.
* **Practical proficiency in using AI agents and AI-enabled tools**
  , with the ability to demonstrate useful business workflows.
* A proven ability to follow up with managers, hold action owners accountable to agreed timelines and escalate issues with sound judgement.
* Ability to understand technical information and communicate it clearly to management.
* Excellent written and spoken English; Marathi and Hindi would be an advantage.
* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook and relevant collaboration tools.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and confidence in coordinating with senior colleagues.
* Dependability, discretion and the ability to manage sensitive information and changing priorities.

**Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate their MIS skills, approach to management follow-up and practical use of AI agents during the selection process.**

title: Lead Analyst Procurement
description:
**Job Description**

**Job Summary**
:

The Lead Analyst Procurement supports category strategy and sourcing activities across the allocated categories. The role contributes market insight, commercial analysis, and structured supplier support to ensure services are sourced and managed in a way that delivers measurable value, operational efficiency, and long-term performance – not only for the assigned categories. Applying category management best practices, the role supports spend analysis, supply market intelligence, industry benchmarking of pricing and service delivery models, supplier segmentation, and the development of sourcing strategies that balance cost efficiency with service quality and innovation. Working closely with the internal stakeholders, the role translates operational priorities into sourcing approaches and supplier solutions. Operating within a global procurement framework, the role supports consistent application of category strategy, sourcing governance, and supplier management practices, while leveraging digital procurement tools and data-driven insights to improve spend visibility and process efficiency. ESG and supplier diversity considerations are applied as part of broader sourcing decisions, in line with company policy.

**Major Responsibilities:**

1. Conduct spend data analysis and generate actionable insights, identifying cost drivers, spending patterns, supplier concentration, and opportunities for savings and improved contract coverage
2. Support the development and execution of category strategies incorporating spend analysis, supply market intelligence, and industry benchmarking of pricing, supplier practices, and service delivery models to inform sourcing direction and stakeholder recommendations
3. Analyze market trends, to identify solutions that meet business needs across the categories in scope
4. Contribute to measurable value creation through sourcing initiatives and supplier engagement that deliver cost savings, improved cash flow, stronger supplier performance, effective risk mitigation, and supplier-led innovation
5. Identify opportunities to optimize supplier footprint, service delivery models, and commercial structures
6. Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal stakeholders to understand business requirements and ensure procurement activities support operational priorities
7. Support competitive sourcing processes including RFI and RFP, supplier negotiations, and contract award in line with company procurement policies and governance requirements
8. Assist in supplier performance monitoring through clear service expectations, performance reviews, and issue resolution to ensure reliable service delivery
9. Support contract management and supplier governance to ensure compliance with agreed commercial terms, service levels, and risk requirements, including data privacy considerations and appropriate regard for ESG and supplier diversity
10. Contribute to process simplification and supply base rationalization to reduce complexity, improve service consistency, and strengthen commercial leverage
11. Monitor category spend, supplier concentration, and contract coverage, leveraging digital procurement tools and data-driven insights to identify opportunities for cost control, efficiency, and risk mitigation

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Value delivered across the categories in scope including cost savings, cash improvement, service quality, and risk mitigation, benchmarked against industry standards
* Quality and actionability of spend data analysis, market intelligence, and industry benchmarking delivered to support category strategy and sourcing decisions
* Delivery of sourcing initiatives and contracts
* Supplier performance against agreed service levels including quality, reliability, responsiveness, and issue resolution
* Compliance with Procurement policy, contracting standards, and applicable regulations including data privacy and basic ESG requirements
* Continuity and reliability of critical services
* Timely execution of sourcing processes including RFI, RFP, negotiations, and contract implementation
* Supply base effectiveness including appropriate supplier coverage, service consistency, and managed risk exposure
* Effective use of digital procurement tools and data-driven insights to improve spend visibility and process efficiency
* Growing personal capability, engagement, and effectiveness within the Procurement team

**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience Requirements:**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Supply Chain, or a related field
* Working knowledge of data analytics tools such as Excel or Power BI as well as AI tools
* Working knowledge of procurement platforms such as SAP Ariba is a plus
* Foundational knowledge or coursework in project management is a plus

**Experience**

* Minimum of 5 years in procurement, strategic sourcing, or category management, including exposure to service-based categories, within global or multi-regional organizations
* Hands-on experience with spend data analysis and procurement analytics, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate findings into clear, actionable insights for category strategy and stakeholder recommendations
* Demonstrated experience supporting category strategies and sourcing initiatives that delivered measurable cost savings, cash flow improvement, stronger supplier performance, effective risk mitigation, and supplier-driven solutions
* Experience conducting market benchmarking, supply market intelligence, and spend analysis to inform sourcing direction and category strategy
* Commercial acumen and developing negotiation skills, with the ability to support competitive sourcing processes and evaluate commercial proposals, payment structures, and supplier agreements
* Financial analysis skills including Total Cost of Ownership modeling and basic cash flow concepts applied to supplier agreements
* Experience supporting supplier management and service contracts in global organizations, including performance tracking and SLA governance
* Good understanding of procurement systems and digital tools supporting sourcing, contracting, and spend management, including SAP Ariba or equivalent platforms, with the ability to leverage data to drive visibility and process improvement
* Basic awareness of data privacy requirements and ESG principles

**Additional Information**

**Our Benefits**

* Volunteer time off
